Both tmp directories existed before execution.

- Exact common stdout and stderr are retained per row as JSON string literals (JSON `\n` encodes line breaks; HTML entities escape Markdown pipes). Each row applies to both gates. Figure count and derive-entry count were equal for every retained ledger.
